# threepipe

> A 3D web framework built on three.js. Load a model, add plugins, render.

- Examples, their source and how to use threepipe: https://threepipe.org/examples/llms.txt
- Guide: https://threepipe.org/guide/getting-started.html
- API reference: https://threepipe.org/docs/
- Source: https://github.com/repalash/threepipe
